claims.statement: Dynamic-price household contracts grew from 135 to 4,836 during 2025, 48% of customers had smart meters, and hourly prosumer settlement rewards active consumption management.
URE recorded 33 hours of negative wholesale prices across five June 2025 dates, evidencing periods when poorly timed export or consumption destroys value.
Likely payers are prosumers and installers seeking higher battery or flexible-load savings; the investable saving per site is unknown.

commercial_mechanics.budget_owner: Household prosumer or small-business energy owner
commercial_mechanics.bundling_resistance: Inverter and retailer apps can bundle scheduling; independence across brands and tariff-aware verified savings must justify purchase
commercial_mechanics.customer_relationship_owner: Unknown today; proposed installer-referred direct contracts with prosumers
commercial_mechanics.distribution_origin: Renewable-energy installers, including a legally separate pilot channel through the family company if formally agreed

fully_loaded_economics.acquisition_cost: Assumption: 300-900 PLN per activated site through installer channels; unknown
fully_loaded_economics.cash_conversion: Hardware/setup payment upfront and software annually in advance
fully_loaded_economics.contribution_margin: Assumption: 55-75% blended margin after gateway, cloud, and installer commission
fully_loaded_economics.delivery_and_support_costs: Assumption: 2-4 remote hours per installation plus field work performed and charged by installer
fully_loaded_economics.overhead_and_compliance: Electrical-product safety, cybersecurity, warranties, and GDPR; exact certification scope unknown
fully_loaded_economics.revenue_basis: Setup fee plus annual optimization subscription
fully_loaded_economics.variable_costs: Gateway, connectivity, price feeds, cloud, installer commission, and support

commercial_mechanics.likely_incumbent_response: Inverter manufacturers and energy retailers add native tariff optimization
commercial_mechanics.paid_event_or_measurable_loss: Current electricity-bill loss from exporting or consuming in unfavorable hourly periods and from underused batteries or flexible loads
commercial_mechanics.purchase_trigger: Switch to hourly settlement, battery installation, or evidence of poor export timing
commercial_mechanics.renewal_event: Annual renewal after a savings report shows value above subscription price

contrary_evidence: Only 4,836 households used dynamic contracts at end-2025, so the immediate segment remains small.
Four of ten suppliers produced average prices below the former cap, meaning savings are profile-dependent rather than automatic.

critical_control_point.acquisition_instrument: Proposed nonexclusive installer distribution and customer device-data authorization agreements; unsigned
critical_control_point.counterparty_refusal_fallback: Sell a read-only tariff simulator from customer-uploaded bills and standard inverter exports
critical_control_point.current_owner: Customers own devices and authorize data; inverter vendors control APIs; no rights are currently held
critical_control_point.customer_relationship_owner: Unknown today; proposed installer-referred direct contracts with prosumers
critical_control_point.founder_access_description: A family operating relationship may support a legally documented pilot, but no family-company customer list, device data, or distribution right is assumed
critical_control_point.launch_controller: Prospective business for recommendations after authorization; customer and inverter remain execution controllers
critical_control_point.subject: Cross-brand access to meter, inverter, battery, and tariff data

economics.acquisition_route: Start with bill-and-production simulation, validate savings on 20 consented sites, then add one inverter integration and installer resale
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Assumption: 8,000 sites at 600 PLN annual recurring revenue plus setup revenue can support over 1m PLN owner earnings or a 5m+ PLN recurring-software equity value in 6-9 years; API access, churn, and savings dispersion are unknown.
economics.founder_time: 15-25 hours weekly initially; field work delegated to installers
economics.gross_margin_basis: Subscription and setup revenue less gateway hardware, feeds, cloud, channel commission, and support
economics.payback: Assumption: 6-12 months if a 500 PLN channel cost yields 60-100 PLN monthly contribution
economics.pricing: Assumption: 800-1,500 PLN setup and 40-80 PLN monthly
economics.retention_or_repeat: Annual while dynamic tariffs, batteries, and flexible loads remain in use

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Cross-brand performance benchmarks and verified dispatch outcomes
fingerprint.customer: Polish residential and microbusiness PV/battery owners
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Tariff-aware energy optimizer with setup plus subscription
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Prosumer pays to recover bill value lost to mistimed export and consumption
fingerprint.problem_trigger: Hourly settlement and dynamic tariffs make passive energy behavior economically visible

founder_fit: Family renewable-energy context offers a potential arm's-length pilot path.
Quantitative optimization fits the founder's data-science background.
A partner-led installation model limits constant selling.
risks: Savings may be too small for many households.
Closed inverter APIs can block automation.
Electrical or control failures could create warranty disputes.

structural_signature.control_point_descriptor: installer mediated activation at battery commissioning
structural_signature.critical_dependency_descriptor: customer authorized meter and inverter telemetry

structure.critical_dependency: Reliable device APIs and measurable customer savings

thesis: Rapid growth in dynamic tariffs and hourly prosumer settlement creates a new purchasing window for independently verified load and battery optimization.
title: Tariff-Aware Prosumer Flex Optimizer
uncertainties: Savings distribution by household profile is unknown.
Family-company willingness to pilot is unknown.
Supported inverter coverage and warranty implications are unknown.
